items.title: Call to Order
notes: Regional Chair K. Redman called the meeting to order at 9:04 a.m.

items.title: Land Acknowledgement
notes: Regional Chair K. Redman provided a land acknowledgement.

items.title: Declarations of Pecuniary Interest under the “Municipal Conflict of Interest Act”
Investing in a Growing Community Workshop - Exploring a New Deal for Waterloo Region
Investing in a Growing Community (Staff Presentation)
notes: Mathieu Goetzke, Acting Chief Administrative Officer, provided opening remarks and introduced Staff. Connie MacDonald, Chief Communications & Strategy Officer, Peter Sweeney, Commissioner of Community Services, Dr. Hsiu-Li Wang, Commissioner Public Health & Paramedic Services/Medical Officer of Health, and Cheryl Braan, Acting Commissioner of Corporate Services. Staff provided updates on various services provided by the Region including both housing and public health. Staff noted the increasing community pressures in balancing community needs with the projected 2025 budget increases to maintain and expand services.

items.title: Association of Municipalities of Ontario Presentation – Social and Economic Prosperity Review
notes: Brian Rosborough and Lindsay Jones, Association of Municipalities of Ontario (AMO) representatives, presented on Ontario Social and Economic Prosperity Review. A copy of the presentation is attached to the minutes. They expressed concern about the current fiscal framework as municipalities require additional resources to both maintain and expand community services.

items.title: Discussion
notes: Roundtable discussions were held to deliberate on the development of a new fiscal framework for the Region and collaboration opportunities with other levels of government and community organizations to ensure sustainability as it relates to municipal budgeting

motions.text: That the meeting adjourn at 10:33 a.m.
